name: gatehold
description: Gatehold — serverless ticket-drop backend with concurrency-safe holds, sagas, and mass refunds

scripts.build:go-lambdas: npm run build:hold-sweeper && npm run build:stream-relay && npm run build:notify-email
scripts.deploy:local: npm run build:go-lambdas && cd infra && npx cdklocal bootstrap --context stage=dev && npx cdklocal deploy --all --require-approval never --context stage=dev --outputs-file ../.cdk-outputs.json
scripts.deploy:aws: npm run build:go-lambdas && cd infra && unset AWS_ENDPOINT_URL AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 && npx cdk bootstrap --context stage=dev && npx cdk deploy --all --require-approval never --context stage=dev --outputs-file ../.cdk-outputs.json
scripts.destroy:aws: cd infra && unset AWS_ENDPOINT_URL AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 && npx cdk destroy --all
scripts.test: node --require ts-node/register/transpile-only --test services/shared/src/auth.test.ts services/shared/src/hold.test.ts services/shared/src/order.test.ts services/shared/src/types.test.ts services/shared/src/ledger.test.ts services/shared/src/secrets.test.ts services/shared/src/ssm.test.ts services/shared/src/ticket.test.ts services/admin-authorizer/src/handler.test.ts services/hold-seat/src/handler.test.ts services/create-order/src/handler.test.ts services/saga-starter/src/handler.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/verify-hold.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/authorize-payment.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/confirm-seat.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/capture-payment.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/issue-ticket.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/mark-confirmed.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/release-seat.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/mark-failed.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/void-authorization.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/refund-payment.test.ts services/saga-steps/src/mark-refunded.test.ts
scripts.local:ready: npm run ministack:up && npm run ministack:health && set -a && . ./.env.example && set +a && npm run deploy:local && npm run seed
